name: CKEditor Audio Plugin
description: Custom CKEditor 5 plugin that uploads or links audio files and inserts an HTML5 <audio> player into rich-text content.
project_description:
Ckeditor5 Audio Plugin 
 Introduction 
 This module integrates an audio plugin into CKEditor5, enabling users to easily upload audio files or embed audio from a link directly within the CKEditor5 content editor. It provides a seamless experience for adding audio to content.

 Features 
 Allows users to upload audio files directly into CKEditor5 or embed audio from external links.

 Requirements 
 CKEditor5
